LESSON: ACTIVE LISTENING

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Active LISTENING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Active LISTENING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Answer questions after listening to a story.
2. Respond to simple instructions in and out of school.
3. Appreciate the contribution of others during conversations. content and imitate. instructions and encouraged to respond. could be guided to take turns in conversations and answer simple questions. 6 clips of their own conversations as they are appreciated and corrected. appreciate the contribution of others during conversations. involved in verbal games, songs, poems and rhymes that involve turn taking. activity involving turn taking. Core-competence developed: Digital literacy, communication and collaboration, critical thinking and problem solving, learning to learn.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Answer questions after listening to a story.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to answer questions after listening to a story. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Respond to simple instructions in and out of school.

Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Active LISTENING.
2. Explain Active LISTENING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Active LISTENING.
4. Show that you can: Answer questions after listening to a story.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Active LISTENING. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Active LISTENING important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

2. Respond to simple instructions in and out of school.
